paragraphs: Camino sells permitting and licensing software to government agencies. The system is meant for building, planning, business and event applications. A companion product, now called the Clariti Guide, works alongside software an agency already has to help applicants better understand the process.

Each application type is configured with a tailored workflow that keeps every step in order. Staff conduct digital plan review in the system and track multiple review cycles. Applicants can request or schedule inspections online. The Guide checks automatically whether a business or construction process is allowed based on the zone, and identifies extra approvals that may be required. It also estimates the fees owed for a project and how long approval might take.

Camino is now a Clariti brand. The permitting and licensing system it sold under its own name is now called Clariti Launch. Among the results listed on the site is a 70% decrease in the length of permit counter visits. Another says a permit portal was live one month after starting with Camino.

quote.text: Build and launch new workflows in minutes.
